d.seg: नंबर है मेरे नंबर हमको सिलेक्ट करें नंबर है मेरे व्हाट्सएप हमको सिलेक्ट करें
d.tr: My number is, select my number, my WhatsApp number is, select my WhatsApp number
d.ctx: The call starts with greetings, and the speaker then immediately starts mentioning their number and WhatsApp.
d.j: The speaker is explicitly asking the other party to select their WhatsApp number, which is a strong case for proposing contact outside the app.
